facts.fact: The Minister of State Domains and Land Affairs said the ministry has completed digitisation of over 10,000 state properties into a unified database, with the Office of Topography and Cadastre and the National Remote Sensing Centre.
The minister announced the launch of a priority registration project for public state properties, with an initial budget of 900,000 dinars.
